title: "Malaysian Grocery Price Tracker"
subtitle: "Helping Malaysians understand grocery price trends across all 16 states"

jupyter: python3

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from datetime import date, datetime

# ── Dynamic month range (always last 6 completed months) ─────────────────────
def _last_n_months(n=6):
    y, m = date.today().year, date.today().month - 1
    if m == 0:
        m, y = 12, y - 1
    months = []
    for _ in range(n):
        months.append(f"{y}-{m:02d}")
        m -= 1
        if m == 0:
            m, y = 12, y - 1
    return list(reversed(months))

MONTHS = _last_n_months(6)
MONTH_LABELS = {m: datetime.strptime(m, "%Y-%m").strftime("%b %Y") for m in MONTHS}

BASKET_CATEGORIES = [
    "AYAM", "TELUR", "BERAS", "MINYAK DAN LEMAK",
    "BAWANG", "SAYUR-SAYURAN", "BAHAN LAUT", "IKAN DARAT", "BUAH-BUAHAN",
]
CATEGORY_LABELS = {
    "AYAM": "Chicken", "TELUR": "Eggs", "BERAS": "Rice",
    "MINYAK DAN LEMAK": "Cooking Oil", "BAWANG": "Onions",
    "SAYUR-SAYURAN": "Vegetables", "BAHAN LAUT": "Seafood",
    "IKAN DARAT": "Freshwater Fish", "BUAH-BUAHAN": "Fruits",
}

# ── Load data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
item    = pd.read_parquet("https://storage.data.gov.my/pricecatcher/lookup_item.parquet",    dtype_backend="numpy_nullable")
premise = pd.read_parquet("https://storage.data.gov.my/pricecatcher/lookup_premise.parquet", dtype_backend="numpy_nullable")
item_clean    = item.dropna(subset=["item_code","item","unit","item_category"]).copy()
premise_clean = premise.dropna(subset=["premise_code","premise","premise_type","state"]).copy()

frames = []
for month in MONTHS:
    try:
        url  = f"https://storage.data.gov.my/pricecatcher/pricecatcher_{month}.parquet"
        temp = pd.read_parquet(url, dtype_backend="numpy_nullable")
        temp["date"]  = pd.to_datetime(temp["date"])
        temp["month"] = temp["date"].dt.to_period("M").astype(str)
        frames.append(temp)
    except Exception:
        pass  # month not yet published — skip gracefully

price_all = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
df = (
    price_all
    .merge(item_clean,    on="item_code",    how="left")
    .merge(premise_clean, on="premise_code", how="left")
)
df = df[df["price"] > 0].copy()
lo, hi = df["price"].quantile(0.01), df["price"].quantile(0.99)
df = df[(df["price"] >= lo) & (df["price"] <= hi)].copy()

for col in ["item","unit","item_category","premise_type","state"]:
    df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip().str.replace(r"\s+", " ", regex=True)

df = df[df["item_category"].isin(BASKET_CATEGORIES)].copy()

latest_month = df["month"].max()
latest_label = MONTH_LABELS.get(latest_month, latest_month)
date_range   = f"{MONTH_LABELS[MONTHS[0]]} – {MONTH_LABELS[MONTHS[-1]]}"
```

::: {.callout-note}
Data covers **`{python} date_range`** · Source: [PriceCatcher, data.gov.my](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue?search=pricecatcher) · Refreshed automatically each month via GitHub Actions.
:::

## Key Metrics — `{python} latest_label`

```{python}
state_latest  = df[df["month"] == latest_month].groupby("state")["price"].mean()
national_avg  = df[df["month"] == latest_month]["price"].mean()
prev_month    = sorted(df["month"].unique())[-2] if len(df["month"].unique()) > 1 else latest_month
prev_avg      = df[df["month"] == prev_month]["price"].mean()
national_chg  = (national_avg - prev_avg) / prev_avg * 100

cheapest_state = state_latest.idxmin()
cheapest_price = state_latest.min()
priciest_state = state_latest.idxmax()
priciest_price = state_latest.max()
spread         = priciest_price - cheapest_price

print(f"""
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| 🇲🇾 National avg item price | **RM {national_avg:.2f}** ({national_chg:+.1f}% vs last month) |
| 🥇 Cheapest state | **{cheapest_state}** · RM {cheapest_price:.2f} |
| 🔴 Most expensive state | **{priciest_state}** · RM {priciest_price:.2f} |
| ↔️ Price spread | **RM {spread:.2f}** between cheapest and most expensive |
""")
```

## State Price Comparison

```{python}
state_avg = (
    df[df["month"] == latest_month]
    .groupby("state")["price"].mean()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"price": "avg_price"})
    .sort_values("avg_price")
)

fig = px.bar(
    state_avg, x="avg_price", y="state", orientation="h",
    color="avg_price",
    color_continuous_scale=["#4ade80", "#FFD166", "#ef4444"],
    labels={"avg_price": "Average Item Price (RM)", "state": ""},
    text=state_avg["avg_price"].map(lambda x: f"RM {x:.2f}"),
    title=f"Average Grocery Item Price by State · {latest_label}",
)
fig.update_layout(
    height=460, coloraxis_showscale=False,
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font=dict(family="DM Sans", color="white"),
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=True, gridcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=False),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=80, t=40, b=0),
    title_font=dict(size=14),
)
fig.update_traces(textposition="outside")
fig.show()
```

## Price Trends — Last 6 Months

```{python}
trend_df = (
    df.groupby(["month","item_category"])["price"].mean()
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values("month")
)
trend_df["month_label"]    = trend_df["month"].map(MONTH_LABELS)
trend_df["category_label"] = trend_df["item_category"].map(lambda x: CATEGORY_LABELS.get(x, x))

fig2 = px.line(
    trend_df, x="month_label", y="price", color="category_label",
    markers=True,
    labels={"price": "Avg Price (RM)", "month_label": "", "category_label": "Category"},
    title="Monthly Average Price by Category (National)",
)
fig2.update_layout(
    height=420,
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font=dict(family="DM Sans", color="white"),
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=True, gridcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", title="Average Price (RM)"),
    legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02, xanchor="right", x=1),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=60, b=0),
    hovermode="x unified",
    title_font=dict(size=14),
)
fig2.update_traces(line=dict(width=2.5), marker=dict(size=7))
fig2.show()
```

## Month-over-Month Change

```{python}
mom_df = (
    df.groupby(["month","state"])["price"].mean()
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values(["state","month"])
)
mom_df["pct_change"]   = mom_df.groupby("state")["price"].pct_change() * 100
mom_df["month_label"]  = mom_df["month"].map(MONTH_LABELS)
mom_pivot = mom_df.pivot(index="state", columns="month_label", values="pct_change").dropna(how="all")

fig3 = px.imshow(
    mom_pivot,
    color_continuous_scale=["#22c55e", "white", "#ef4444"],
    color_continuous_midpoint=0,
    aspect="auto",
    labels=dict(color="% Change"),
    text_auto=".1f",
    title="Month-over-Month Price Change (%) by State",
)
fig3.update_layout(
    height=420,
    font=dict(family="DM Sans", color="white"),
    paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=40, b=0),
    xaxis_title="", yaxis_title="",
    coloraxis_colorbar=dict(title="%", thickness=12),
    title_font=dict(size=14),
)
fig3.show()
```

## Category Breakdown — Latest Month

```{python}
cat_avg = (
    df[df["month"] == latest_month]
    .groupby("item_category")["price"].agg(["mean","median","std"])
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"mean":"avg_price","median":"median_price","std":"price_std"})
    .sort_values("avg_price")
)
cat_avg["label"] = cat_avg["item_category"].map(lambda x: CATEGORY_LABELS.get(x, x))

fig4 = go.Figure()
fig4.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=cat_avg["avg_price"], y=cat_avg["label"],
    orientation="h", name="Average",
    marker_color="#FFD166",
    error_x=dict(type="data", array=cat_avg["price_std"].tolist(), visible=True, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.3)"),
    text=cat_avg["avg_price"].map(lambda x: f"RM {x:.2f}"),
    textposition="outside",
))
fig4.update_layout(
    height=340, showlegend=False,
    title=f"Average Price per Category · {latest_label} (error bars = std dev)",
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font=dict(family="DM Sans", color="white"),
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=True, gridcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)", title="Price (RM)"),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=False),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=80, t=40, b=0),
    title_font=dict(size=14),
)
fig4.show()
```
